WITH sma_10005_cte AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('day', ordered_at) AS metric_time__day
    , status AS order__status
    , 1 AS __order_count
    , case when status = 'paid' then 1 else 0 end AS __paid_order_count
    , case when status = 'paid' and paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 then 1 else 0 end AS __valid_order_count
    , case when status = 'cancelled' then 1 else 0 end AS __cancelled_order_count
    , case when status = 'paid' and refund_cents > 0 then 1 else 0 end AS __refund_order_count
    , case when status = 'paid' and refund_cents > 0 and refund_cents < paid_cents then 1 else 0 end AS __partial_refund_order_count
    , case when status = 'paid' and paid_cents > 0 and refund_cents = paid_cents then 1 else 0 end AS __full_refund_order_count
    , case when status = 'paid' then paid_cents else 0 end AS __payment_cents
    , case when status = 'paid' then refund_cents else 0 end AS __refund_cents
    , case when status = 'paid' then paid_cents - refund_cents else 0 end AS __net_sales_cents
    , case when status = 'paid' then gross_cents else 0 end AS __gross_cents
    , case when status = 'paid' then gross_cents - paid_cents else 0 end AS __discount_cents
    , case when status = 'paid' and paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 then member_id end AS __buyer_count
    , case when status = 'paid' and refund_cents > 0 then member_id end AS __refund_buyer_count
    , case when status = 'paid' and paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 then store_id end AS __selling_store_count
    , case when status = 'paid' and paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 then quantity else 0 end AS __valid_order_items
  FROM "data"."main"."orders_enriched" order_semantic_src_10000
)

SELECT
  MAX(subq_23.order_count) AS order_count
  , MAX(subq_23.paid_order_count) AS paid_order_count
  , MAX(subq_23.valid_order_count) AS valid_order_count
  , MAX(subq_23.cancelled_order_count) AS cancelled_order_count
  , MAX(subq_23.refund_order_count) AS refund_order_count
  , MAX(subq_23.partial_refund_order_count) AS partial_refund_order_count
  , MAX(subq_23.full_refund_order_count) AS full_refund_order_count
  , MAX(subq_23.payment_cents) AS payment_cents
  , MAX(subq_23.refund_cents) AS refund_cents
  , MAX(subq_23.net_sales_cents) AS net_sales_cents
  , MAX(subq_23.gross_cents) AS gross_cents
  , MAX(subq_23.discount_cents) AS discount_cents
  , MAX(subq_23.buyer_count) AS buyer_count
  , MAX(subq_23.refund_buyer_count) AS refund_buyer_count
  , MAX(subq_23.selling_store_count) AS selling_store_count
  , MAX(subq_23.valid_order_items) AS valid_order_items
  , MAX(subq_31.avg_order_value) AS avg_order_value
  , MAX(subq_31.avg_buyer_value) AS avg_buyer_value
  , MAX(subq_31.purchase_frequency) AS purchase_frequency
  , MAX(subq_31.refund_amount_rate) AS refund_amount_rate
  , MAX(subq_31.cancel_rate) AS cancel_rate
  , MAX(subq_31.refund_order_rate) AS refund_order_rate
  , MAX(subq_31.discount_rate) AS discount_rate
  , MAX(subq_31.items_per_order) AS items_per_order
FROM (
  SELECT
    SUM(order_count) AS order_count
    , SUM(paid_order_count) AS paid_order_count
    , SUM(valid_order_count) AS valid_order_count
    , SUM(cancelled_order_count) AS cancelled_order_count
    , SUM(refund_order_count) AS refund_order_count
    , SUM(partial_refund_order_count) AS partial_refund_order_count
    , SUM(full_refund_order_count) AS full_refund_order_count
    , SUM(payment_cents) AS payment_cents
    , SUM(refund_cents) AS refund_cents
    , SUM(net_sales_cents) AS net_sales_cents
    , SUM(gross_cents) AS gross_cents
    , SUM(discount_cents) AS discount_cents
    , COUNT(DISTINCT buyer_count) AS buyer_count
    , COUNT(DISTINCT refund_buyer_count) AS refund_buyer_count
    , COUNT(DISTINCT selling_store_count) AS selling_store_count
    , SUM(valid_order_items) AS valid_order_items
  FROM (
    SELECT
      order__status
      , __order_count AS order_count
      , __paid_order_count AS paid_order_count
      , __valid_order_count AS valid_order_count
      , __cancelled_order_count AS cancelled_order_count
      , __refund_order_count AS refund_order_count
      , __partial_refund_order_count AS partial_refund_order_count
      , __full_refund_order_count AS full_refund_order_count
      , __payment_cents AS payment_cents
      , __refund_cents AS refund_cents
      , __net_sales_cents AS net_sales_cents
      , __gross_cents AS gross_cents
      , __discount_cents AS discount_cents
      , __buyer_count AS buyer_count
      , __refund_buyer_count AS refund_buyer_count
      , __selling_store_count AS selling_store_count
      , __valid_order_items AS valid_order_items
    FROM sma_10005_cte
    WHERE metric_time__day BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
  ) subq_19
  WHERE order__status in ('cancelled')
) subq_23
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT
    CAST(SUM(net_sales_cents) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(SUM(valid_order_count), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS avg_order_value
    , CAST(SUM(net_sales_cents) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT buyer_count), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS avg_buyer_value
    , CAST(SUM(valid_order_count) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT buyer_count), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS purchase_frequency
    , CAST(SUM(refund_cents) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(SUM(payment_cents), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS refund_amount_rate
    , CAST(SUM(cancelled_order_count) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(SUM(order_count), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS cancel_rate
    , CAST(SUM(refund_order_count) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(SUM(paid_order_count), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS refund_order_rate
    , CAST(SUM(discount_cents) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(SUM(gross_cents), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS discount_rate
    , CAST(SUM(valid_order_items) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(SUM(valid_order_count), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS items_per_order
  FROM (
    SELECT
      order__status
      , __order_count AS order_count
      , __paid_order_count AS paid_order_count
      , __valid_order_count AS valid_order_count
      , __cancelled_order_count AS cancelled_order_count
      , __refund_order_count AS refund_order_count
      , __payment_cents AS payment_cents
      , __refund_cents AS refund_cents
      , __net_sales_cents AS net_sales_cents
      , __gross_cents AS gross_cents
      , __discount_cents AS discount_cents
      , __buyer_count AS buyer_count
      , __valid_order_items AS valid_order_items
    FROM sma_10005_cte
    WHERE metric_time__day BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
  ) subq_26
  WHERE order__status in ('cancelled')
) subq_31
